0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The savvy stable master's herd is missing an alpaca or two.

25.original: Speak with the savvy stable master.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, isn't it? I've heard all about your affinity with the alpacas! My cousin works on the ranch at Wachunpelo─he was practically gushing.

49.original: As it so happens, I have need of your talents. Some of the herd escaped during the attack on the city the other day. I managed to round most of them up, but we're still two short.

50.original: They haven't been seen leaving via the gates, so I think it's safe to assume they're hiding somewhere within the city walls. So, how about it? Can I ask you to round up those last two stragglers?

51.original: Thank you! Oh, and I'm sure I don't need to tell you, but despite being trained as mounts, alpacas are easily rattled.

52.original: If you come across our stragglers, make sure you <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>soothe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> them first. Got that? No sudden movements!

53.original: The two missing alpacas should be here in the city. Try and find them! And remember to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>soothe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> them before you even think of making your approach!

55.original: In your haste, you find yourself on the receiving end of a glistening gob of alpaca spit. Be sure to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>soothe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> the animal before you approach.

57.original: The suitably soothed animal makes its way nonchalantly back to the alpaca stables.

58.original: Thank you! The two stragglers arrived safe and sound a little while ago.

59.original: A masterful display of alpaca husbandry! No wonder you were asked to play a part in the rite of succession!

60.original: <sniff> I recognize that smell! Let me guess, you ignored my advice and got rewarded with a faceful of alpaca spit? I hope you've learned your lesson... That stink'll be with you for a few days yet!

61.original: These alpacas are direct descendants of the mounts we Pelupelu presented as a sign of friendship when Tuliyollal was founded.

62.original: I'm sure you've heard the tale of Gulool Ja Ja catching a golden alpaca? Well, the creatures we gifted were sired by that shiny beast itself. To say they had quite the pedigree would be a gross undervaluation!

63.original: And you can be sure that their legacy survives today: these beasts are fleet of foot and strong of limb, just like their ancestors. If you ever have need of a mount, you could do far worse than a Tuliyollal alpaca!

64.original: Right, I should tend to the two that you so kindly brought back. I appreciate all the help!
